dynamic_traffic.reservation_note: Inner opposing lanes 6/+1 and 47/+1 are reserved from dynamic spawns. Outer +2 remains available. Dedicated native-rule straight NPCs are unchanged by dynamic spawn reservations. Reservations do not guarantee later TM routes; actual full-run body-clearance audit remains mandatory.

capture_suggestion.note: Pre-roll ego and dedicated NPC physics every official tick. Actual arrival timings, signal state, stop, clearance, route completion and smoothness must be checked from the capture.
capture_suggestion.npc_start_note: NPCs start on road7 positive native lanes at s0.1 and physically advance on every preroll tick. Speeds14/12kmh are intersection approach targets. No time-based release or minimum artificial waiting is added. Actual stopped yield must last >=0.5s while opposing bodies traverse and clear the gate.

required_runtime_features: traffic.controller native_rule and traffic.stages physically controlled each warmup/recorded tick
Permissive opposite-direction green if native junction is signalized; cross traffic retains red. Do not ignore red lights or claim a protected left arrow.
All dedicated and dynamic traffic must pass collision/clearance and actual lane-connector audits.
signal_description: Native three-light signalized junction. Opposite-axis permissive green, transverse red; ego must physically yield to actual straight opposing traffic.
